title: Design: the Matrices list columns, badges and row buttons
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, so the list shows an Active row.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B, which prices no category.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps: 1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The tabs read Tiers, Matrices and Fixed Rules, each with its count in brackets, the Matrices tab selected.
  • Above the list it reads the number of matrices followed by "matrices", with Search, a Status filter, a three-dot button and a blue New Matrix button at the right.
  • The columns read Matrix, Status, Categories, Work Order Matrix, Part Sale Matrix and Tiers, in that order, with sort arrows on Matrix and Categories and an info icon beside Tiers.
  • The General Matrix is the first row, its name bold with a blue Default badge.
  • Active matrices show a green Active badge; matrix B shows a gray Inactive badge and "—" in Categories.
  • Each row ends with a pencil and a three-dot button.
  • Fonts, spacing and alignment match picture 6.2 compared with the design picture at 100% zoom.
  • Today's Pricing Matrices list (Today picture) is replaced by this list.
